versions.changelog: 1.0.2: work-task-only description (never for personal/career goals); approval plan (actions, cost/risk, options) instead of a flat refusal when a gate fires; no credential hunting; 3-rung ladder, backtest of early-warning rules with lead time, three concrete decisions; target stated before executing; mandatory gap report checked by check_report.py. Eval (glm-5.3-flash-external): EN 89.9% vs 68.3% without skill, ZH 93.3% vs 68.8%; career-goals false trigger fixed. Source: https://github.com/linkxzhou/ambition-loop (v1.0.2)

1.0.1: first public release. Fit check, 11 numbered steps, approval gates G1-G5 (denied means stop), external verification, gap report checked by scripts/check_report.py, 8 evals + 20 trigger queries. Ideas from Felix Rieseberg, 'How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models'. Source: https://github.com/linkxzhou/ambition-loop
